newsitem.title: USA: MedPartners unit in prescription pact.
newsitem.headline: MedPartners unit in prescription pact.

text.p: Caremark International Inc, a unit of MedPartners Inc, said on Tuesday it had signed an agreement with Zilveren Kruis Groep -- a healthcare insurance company in the Netherlands -- to introduce a prescription benefit management program in Europe.

The company said that under the agreement, it will provide mail service distribution of prescription pharmaceuticals for 2.5 million people - one-sixth of the population of the Netherlands - who are covered by Zilveren and its four affiliated insurance companies.

It said that its prescription benefit management program, which offers a lower-cost approach to fulfilling prescriptions for chronic medications, supports the goal of the Netherlands' government to reduce the overall cost of healthcare.

Caremark said it plans to introduce the program in phases, with the initial launch of mail service distribution of prescription medications to a group of 5,000 to 10,000 individuals. Within six months the program will encompass the entire Zilveren Kruis population, the company said.
This is the first such program in Europe, the company said.
